debugging_narratives.title: In-Sample Calibration & Chronological 3-Way Splitting
debugging_narratives.assumed: Fitting isotonic regression on the training set would produce calibrated probabilities across all evaluation slices.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: In-sample overfitting where the calibrator memorized train boundaries, collapsing out-of-sample PR-AUC.
debugging_narratives.found_it: Evaluated reliability curve on held-out temporal slice; discovered distorted probability distributions.
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Implemented strict 3-way time split: Train 70% (X_tr), Calibration 15% (X_cal), Held-Out Validation 15% (X_val).

debugging_narratives.title: Terminal Universe Transition Masking (12M Default Audit)
debugging_narratives.assumed: Evaluating all panel rows including pre-existing default / prepaid records produced a 0.9546 ROC-AUC.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: Including terminal-state records allowed the model to memorize already-defaulted states rather than predicting forward transitions.
debugging_narratives.found_it: Audited training universe; found defaulted loans remained in the matrix with static 100% default labels.
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Implemented Transition-Only Universe Masking: strictly excluded terminal records from training, settling at an honest, non-leaky 0.8595 ROC-AUC / 0.3380 PR-AUC.

debugging_narratives.title: Boundary Inference Lag Collapse & State Persistence
debugging_narratives.assumed: Calling transform on test panel records independently would compute rolling DPD and balance momentum.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: Test cohort start (2021-07) lacked preceding 3-month history, causing NaN lag collapse for all 20,000 loans.
debugging_narratives.found_it: Inspected test set feature matrix; discovered top 5 lag features were 100% NaN at month index 1.
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Engineered history_tail_df buffer inside FeatureEngineer to seamlessly persist boundary history across splits.

debugging_narratives.title: Mathematical 4-Layer Weight Calibration via Differential Evolution
debugging_narratives.assumed: Equal 25% weights across ML, Rules, Servicer, and DQ layers would optimize anomaly interception.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: Rule breaches and servicer conflicts have asymmetric contractual severity, diluting critical defect signals.
debugging_narratives.found_it: Differential Evolution optimization proved optimal weights: w_Rule=46.3%, w_ML=36.4%, w_Servicer=13.5%, w_DQ=3.8%.
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Fitted bounded global optimizer solving for maximal Precision-Recall AUC on the training slice.

debugging_narratives.title: Isolation Forest Directional Path-Length Attribution
debugging_narratives.assumed: Standard TreeSHAP log-odds ranking would correctly isolate multivariate anomaly drivers.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: Isolation Forest anomaly score is inversely proportional to tree path length; naive sorting selected normality-inducing features.
debugging_narratives.found_it: Found waterfall plots highlighting low-risk conforming features as anomaly drivers.
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Inverted attribution framework: sorted by lowest algebraic path compression (np.argsort(shap, axis=1)).

debugging_narratives.title: Windows Path Backslash & Python String-Literal Escape Bug
debugging_narratives.assumed: Logging paths like 'src/data/\builder.py' in text templates was purely cosmetic.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: Python string-literal parsing consumed '\b' as ASCII \x08 backspace, stripping the letter 'b' to create 'uilder.py'.
debugging_narratives.found_it: Grep search revealed missing first letters across multiple markdown reports ('uilder.py', 'al_model', 'illna(0)').
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Standardized on POSIX forward slashes repository-wide and enforced raw string literals (r'''...''').

debugging_narratives.title: Operational Rule Reconstruction vs. Behavioral Forecast (exception_required & exception_type)
debugging_narratives.assumed: exception_required (0.9997 ROC-AUC) and exception_type (1.0000 Macro-F1 baseline) were breakthrough classifiers.
debugging_narratives.broke_it: Near-1.0 AUC standing next to 0.86 default and 0.65 prepay indicated deterministic target leakage.
debugging_narratives.found_it: TreeSHAP attribution confirmed 78.7% of weight derived from structural snapshot inputs (maturity_pressure, document_status_enc).
debugging_narratives.fixed_it: Documented transparently that exception targets operate as empirical rule partitioners for instantaneous flags.

accepted_rejected_ai.rationale: 2025Q2 lacked multi-year default and prepayment outcomes (only 12 months old). Swapped to 2019 multi-year Freddie Mac benchmark.
Problem statement explicitly penalizes random splits across panel data. Enforced strict calendar-time cut with per-loan history lag computation prior to split boundary.
Generates all 8 required files with clean forward target labels and ~5% servicer conflict rate for downstream reconciliation tasks.
